findings.assetsOrDecisionAtRisk: Curve inventory and native graduation backing; original locked LP custody.
findings.counterfactualPreconditions: A different or callback-capable token, Permit2 or position manager, a changed runtime/action path, or a settlement balance discrepancy would be required to invalidate the recorded baseline.
findings.sourceMitigationsReviewed: nonReentrant; exact registered fixed-supply TokenV2; dependency code hashes; zero initial allowances; finite ERC20/Permit2 grants with checked expiry; complete allowance consumption; exact engine/manager token/native deltas; original position owner, PoolKey, ticks, liquidity and no subscriber.
findings.limitations: Current exact dependency implementations and TokenV2 semantics are assumptions. Local fault injection is finite and does not establish current deployed identities or external implementation correctness.
findings.deploymentBoundary: No fresh live-chain runtime check in workstream B; source/template binding only.

findings.assetsOrDecisionAtRisk: Recorded curve backing, remaining token inventory and returned dust.
findings.counterfactualPreconditions: An inexact approval, unauthenticated/incorrect refund or changed engine/token behavior would have to survive the final conservation checks.
findings.sourceMitigationsReviewed: Guarded entry; graduation seals trading and clears recorded backing before calls; checked finite approval and zero revoke; bound engine/refund receiver; nonzero pool/position/asset use; exact refund, token and native balance checks; whole-transaction rollback.
findings.limitations: Bound engine and callback-free canonical token remain required. Raw local tests use the untransformed31337 fixture constants, separately from the exact4663 scanner input.
findings.deploymentBoundary: No fresh live-chain runtime check in workstream B; source/template binding only.

findings.assetsOrDecisionAtRisk: Original LP earned native/token fees and permanently locked principal.
findings.counterfactualPreconditions: A changed manager/action/subscriber/hook or incorrect fee/custody observation would have to redirect earned fees or reduce principal without tripping settlement checks.
findings.sourceMitigationsReviewed: Guarded entry; verify original position and zero allowances before/after; only zero-liquidity INCREASE_LIQUIDITY then TAKE_PAIR to immutable ledger; unchanged position liquidity and expected fee growth; exact two-asset ledger increments; subsequent claims debit before transfer.
findings.limitations: Only original custody, exact zero-liquidity action encoding and pinned external implementations are reviewed. No current live fee quote, L1 finality or physical-wallet acceptance is established.
findings.deploymentBoundary: No fresh live-chain runtime check in workstream B; source/template binding only.

findings.assetsOrDecisionAtRisk: Predecessor/successor tracked token inventory, backing and original beneficiary ledger rights.
findings.counterfactualPreconditions: A noncanonical token/ledger, changed admitted successor or inconsistent acceptance would have to alter in-flight balances/authority and survive post-call conservation and route checks.
findings.sourceMitigationsReviewed: Factory-only guarded handoff; successor runtime/commitment/version/source binding; predecessor closes before transfer; successor inactive through call-free ledger writer switch; exact token/native increments/decrements; original ledger identity, writer, active/sold/backing checks; guarded factory/registry views and atomic rollback.
findings.limitations: A pin establishes identity, not correctness of a future admitted implementation. Future successors, callback-capable dependencies and consumers of raw proposal/migrationNonce need separate review. No governance action is authorized.
findings.deploymentBoundary: No fresh live-chain runtime check in workstream B; source/template binding only.

findings.flaggedCallOrExpression: No external call: deliberate XOR inverse seed
findings.assetsOrDecisionAtRisk: Trade/fee allocation and graduation liquidity arithmetic.
findings.counterfactualPreconditions: A wrong full-width division result could misstate reserves, fees or funding. The flagged XOR seed must be evaluated as modular inverse logic, not rewritten as exponentiation.
findings.sourceMitigationsReviewed: Exact pinned dependency bytes; deliberate odd-denominator inverse seed; six Newton refinements; denominator/overflow domain guards. Independent128-bit-limb product/remainder oracle validates the returned quotient and ceiling.
findings.limitations: Oracle samples and exact source semantics support these arithmetic expressions only. They do not clear all external dependency behavior, source-to-deployed correspondence or the strict scanner gate.
findings.deploymentBoundary: No fresh live-chain runtime check in workstream B; source/template binding only.

findings.flaggedCallOrExpression: No external call: Yul packed shift lookup
findings.assetsOrDecisionAtRisk: Bit/tick index selection in included v4 arithmetic paths.
findings.counterfactualPreconditions: A wrong index for a nonzero word could select a wrong bit/tick boundary. Yul shr takes shift count first; the packed lookup intentionally places literals in that operand.
findings.sourceMitigationsReviewed: Exact pinned BitMath source; nonzero domain guard; independent simple-scan oracle, every one-hot bit and dense boundary checks.
findings.limitations: Only exact BitMath operations and nonzero domain are supported. Inclusion of leastSignificantBit in the closure does not by itself prove it is called by the intended local funding graph.
findings.deploymentBoundary: No fresh live-chain runtime check in workstream B; source/template binding only.
